value.rationale: The first noncontractible sizes in a canonical family of nonattacking-piece complexes are structurally natural, not an arbitrary slice. Determining integral homotopy, and the change from a one-dimensional invariant subspace at size four to none at size five despite the same homology degree, goes well beyond classical maximum independent-set counts. The exact finite result supplies reproducible benchmarks and an equivariant distinction for future comparative work.
